question: Does the fixed same-month cap/PE implied total profit agree with separately cached financial TTM under both predeclared clocks?
scope: R117 all944946 rows preserved; only comparison_eligible rows evaluated. Negative PE and TTM retained, no clock selection or re-fit. No prices beyond current month.
metrics: implied=cap/PE. sign agreement using mathematical sign incl zero. symmetric_distance=2*abs(implied-TTM)/(abs(implied)+abs(TTM)), zero/zero=0; absolute CNY distance separately. signed_relative=(implied-TTM)/abs(TTM) only nonzero TTM; abs_log_magnitude_ratio only same nonzero sign. No clipping/winsorization. Diagnostic within1pct/5pct of abs(TTM), not acceptance/PIT thresholds.
cohorts: all eligible per clock; common eligible identities both clocks; partition common into same report_period versus different report_period. Preserve unknown identities and both clock values. No misleading unmatched clock mean attribution.
aggregation: Within each date equal stock-weight mean symmetric_distance/sign/within1/within5 and median absolute/log distances; across dates equal weights; annual detail. Also raw counts/quantiles clearly labeled row-weighted descriptive. Same-period values and implied amount should match exactly between clocks.
limits: Separate numeric agreement, exact report identity, initial-publication PIT, mechanism, prediction and investment value. Matching can share vendor lineage and is not independent source certification. Opposite-sign symmetric distance saturates at2; report magnitude separately.
verification: all source fields, eligibility/unknown propagation, every derived amount, exact clock pairing/cohorts, date/year aggregations and quantiles independently recomputed; synthetic zero/negative/opposite-sign cases
